Definition: Jephunneh, the name of two Israelites
BiblicalUsage: Jephunneh = "He will be facing"; 1) a Kenezite and father of Caleb the spy from the tribe of Judah; 2) son of Jether and descendant of Asher
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
